CFO Native Board

License: /assets/cline-kanban-LICENSE.txt
Source: https://github.com/cline/kanban/tree/abd4912c27ce6b7f18b5a8106c145fd838e90cc4

Modified files and behavior:
Board.tsx adapts column ordering and card selection from kanban-board.tsx.
diff.ts and syntax.tsx adapt patch parsing and language selection from shared/diff-renderer.tsx.
Details.tsx adapts on-demand commit selection and diff presentation from git-history-view.tsx, plus contextual line feedback from detail-panels/diff-viewer-panel.tsx.
stream.ts adapts bounded reconnection from runtime/use-runtime-state-stream.ts.
CFO removes drag-to-progress, automation creation and destructive Git controls; adds durable Go actions, pipeline custody checks, two-sided line coordinates, safe text-token rendering, full SSE snapshots, and evidence-backed lineage.
The pinned upstream tree contains LICENSE and no NOTICE file.

Design tokens are adapted from the inspected local SIQshift brand.css.
Runtime dependencies: React and React DOM (MIT), PrismJS (MIT).
React: https://github.com/facebook/react/blob/main/LICENSE
Prism: https://github.com/PrismJS/prism/blob/master/LICENSE

Bundled React and React DOM license: /assets/react-LICENSE.txt
Bundled PrismJS license: /assets/prism-LICENSE.txt
